intro: Our Innergize mattress is made to recharge you—plush, supportive, and oh-so-comfy, it turns every night into a deeply restful, energy-boosting experience.

features.title: Energy-boosting sleep experience
features.text: Crafted to help you wake up refreshed, the Innergize offers the right blend of support and comfort for truly restorative sleep.

features.title: High-density foam core
features.text: At its core lies dense, supportive foam that holds your shape and supports your body through the night for long-term comfort.

features.title: Enhanced cushioning and comfort
features.text: The Euro-top design adds an extra plush layer, giving you a luxurious, cloud-like surface without compromising support.

features.title: Plush Euro-top surface
features.text: Experience next-level coziness with a soft, cushioned top layer that wraps you in gentle comfort as you drift off to sleep.

features.title: Durable & long lasting build
features.text: Made to stay strong, supportive, and in shape—this mattress is built to serve comfort for years to come.

features.title: Styled for you
features.text: Wrapped in soft, high GSM white and grey fabric that adds a premium touch and elevates your bedroom’s look.

name: Innergize Single Bed Foam Mattress 75 X 35 X 6 Inches
